mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id FROM visit v JOIN member m ON m.member_id = v.member_id AND m.is_active = TRUE JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id AND p.is_active = TRUE WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} AND LOWER(p.language) = LOWER(m.locale) ORDER BY v.created_at DESC LIMIT 10
mapper.update: UPDATE visit v JOIN place p ON p.place_id = v.place_id JOIN place target ON target.place_group_id = p.place_group_id AND LOWER(target.language) = LOWER(#{language}) AND target.is_active = TRUE SET v.place_id = target.place_id WHERE v.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.place_group_id IS NOT NULL AND p.is_active = TRUE AND p.place_id <> target.place_id
